title: Economic sentiment and climate transition during the COVID-19 pandemic
publisher: In Goutte, Guesmi and Urom (eds), Financial Market Dynamics after COVID 19, Springer, ch. 8
summary: The chapter examines how a newspaper-based US economic sentiment index relates to four climate-themed financial indices after COVID-19 began. Dependence varies across time horizons and market conditions.
keyFindings: In very poor market conditions, the strongest link is between sentiment and the green bonds index over intermediate horizons.
In normal conditions, the other climate indices show rising dependence across weekly, monthly and yearly cycles.
At the pandemic's peak, dependence under normal returns was mostly positive.
